title: Brik Capability Contract Manifest v1
description: Declarative manifest describing a capability contract: the set of operations every provider of a capability must implement. brik codes once against the contract; providers are interchangeable as long as they satisfy it. The contract id (metadata.id) is the versioned string providers reference via spec.contract.

id.description: Versioned contract id (<capability>/v<n>), the exact string providers reference via spec.contract.

capability.description: Capability this contract governs. Must match the capability of every provider that references it.

required_operations.description: Operations a provider module must expose as providers.<module>.<op>. Introspected at bind time (presence-only, fail-closed); behaviour is asserted by the contract's conformance specs.
